people.name: Daniel
people.line: Prophet in Babylon, known for wisdom and visions

translations.web: Now God made Daniel find kindness and compassion in the sight of the prince of the eunuchs.
translations.bsb: Now God had granted Daniel favor and compassion from the chief official,
translations.kjv: Now God had brought Daniel into favour and tender love with the prince of the eunuchs.
translations.asv: Now God made Daniel to find kindness and compassion in the sight of the prince of the eunuchs.
